messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy check failed — env parity alert.
deploy-bot: Target service: inference-worker (canary). Keystore secret type mismatch between prod and staging.
deploy-bot: Diff snippet:```prod: MODEL_CONFIG: {"model":"redwood-v1", "kv_prefix":"/cache/ri/"}
staging: MODEL_CONFIG: "{\"model\":\"redwood-v1\",\"kv_prefix\":\"/cache/ri/\"}"```
mia.dev: ugh, that's why the canary crashed earlier. did the deploy process double-serialize? :eyes:
raj.ops: confirmed logs show JSON.parse error in startup. staging process tried to parse a string and blew up.
mia.dev: any idea how staging ended up with stringified JSON? migration/secret-write bug?
sasha.pm: we have a release window at 17:00 PT. if we hold, what's the ETA to fix and validate? need to update release notes and stakeholders.
leo.releases: suggestion: pin the model variant for this rollout to avoid automatic fallback differences. also hold promotion until parity is restored.
kyle.sre: backfill script exists to normalize MODEL_CONFIG: `scripts/normalize-secret --env=staging --key=MODEL_CONFIG --format=json` — dry-run ok.
mia.dev: could we patch the runtime to accept both object and stringified JSON as a quick temporary mitigation?
raj.ops: runtime shim is tempting but smells like hiding the parity problem. prefer to normalize staging so we match prod exactly.
sasha.pm: decision needed: hotpatch runtime vs backfill + hold. timeboxed?
leo.releases: prefer backfill + pin. I'll pin the release and add note in the deploy queue.
deploy-bot: Release pinned: release/2026-03-18 by leo.releases. Promotion blocked until `INF-7421` is resolved.
mia.dev: creating INF-7421 (secret-normalization + validate canary). assigning to raj.ops and kyle.sre.
raj.ops: will run backfill in ~30m during quiet traffic, then run canary validation suite. ETA ~45m incl. checks.
kyle.sre: running dry-run now, no surprises. planning prod-like validation: smoke + kv-cache sanity tests.
infra-bot: dry-run reported: 0 failed, 1 changed (staging/MODEL_CONFIG normalized).
sasha.pm: I'll update release notes: "Hold: staging keystore normalization. Release will resume after verification (INF-7421)." and notify PMs + legal if needed.
leo.releases: also pinning version on deploy queue: `deploybot pin release/2026-03-18 --version=rev-20260318` to avoid auto-roll-forward.
deploy-bot: Pin acknowledged.
mia.dev: postmortem item added: investigate why the secret writer double-serialized (likely client lib). tagging infra and sdk teams.
raj.ops: backfill finished, canary validations green. will start promoting when Sasha confirms window.
sasha.pm: window still open for minor promotion; proceed with caution. please include change note in prod release.
infra-bot: canary passed after normalized secret. Promotion scheduled for next maintenance window.
sasha.pm: thanks all — releasing hold and updating notes :thumbsup:
leo.releases: closing the thread once promotion completes. good catch by deploy-bot and quick turnaround.
